decisions.reason: Tightening document spacing does not change Canva editing access, ownership, or asset restrictions.
The spacing change does not alter the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional in the final file.
The source concerns spacing in the current proposal and does not resume or modify the deferred reusable-template requirement.
Reducing spacing does not change the required PDF format, count, email submission method, or export compatibility.
The candidate already has a message-91 MODIFY recording tightened paragraph and section spacing, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The separate message-91 instruction to condense the first-page letter to one page is already represented by this candidate's INTRODUCE Event; the page-limit spacing policy adds no further change.
The spacing policy does not change the approved photo source, mandatory selections, or photo-placement requirement.
Tightening spacing does not change the requirement to include the organization chart in the final draft.
The page-limit adjustment does not change which tables must be integrated or the approved revised-table source.
The spacing change does not alter the Blue Mesa Strategies identity or required brand elements.
The client only conditionally offers to cut content during a later review; no current content-inclusion change is established.
The spacing policy does not change the biography count, affiliation, population method, or biography source.
